attacks.name: Warhammer +1
attacks.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands. On a hit, Argamon can push a Large or smaller target up to 10 feet straight away from himself.

attacks.name: Javelin
attacks.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. On a hit, Argamon can reduce the target's speed by 10 feet until the start of his next turn.

attacks.name: Breath Weapon
attacks.description: Argamon exhales fire in either a 15-foot cone or a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

attacks.name: Dragon Fear
attacks.description: Argamon expends one use of Breath Weapon and roars. Each creature of his choice within 30 feet that can see or hear him must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute.

attacks.name: Divine Smite
attacks.description: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend a spell slot to deal radiant damage.

features.name: Aura of Protection
entries: Argamon and his allies within 10 feet of him gain a +3 bonus to saving throws. The aura is inactive while Argamon has the Incapacitated condition.

features.name: Spellcasting
entries: Argamon's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks).

features.name: Supernatural Readiness
entries: While Argamon is attuned to and carrying his Longsword of Warning, he has advantage on initiative rolls.

features.name: Fire Resistance
entries: Argamon has resistance to fire damage.

features.name: Multiattack
entries: Argamon makes two attacks using Warhammer +1 or Javelin. He can replace one attack with Breath Weapon.

features.name: Conquering Presence
entries: Argamon uses Channel Divinity. Each creature of his choice that he can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute.

features.name: Faithful Steed
entries: Argamon can cast find steed without expending a spell slot. He regains this use when he finishes a long rest.

features.name: Lay on Hands
entries: Argamon touches a creature and restores up to 25 hit points from his healing pool. He can instead expend 5 points from the pool to remove the Poisoned condition.

features.name: Divine Sense
entries: For 10 minutes, or until Argamon has the Incapacitated condition, he knows the location and creature type of Celestials, Fiends, and Undead within 60 feet.

features.name: Draconic Flight
entries: Argamon sprouts spectral wings for 10 minutes and gains a flying speed of 30 feet.

features.name: Summon Knight's Fellowship Spirit
entries: Argamon summons a warrior spirit in an unoccupied space within 30 feet. The spirit lasts for 1 minute or until reduced to 0 hit points.

features.name: Paladin's Smite
entries: Argamon can cast divine smite once without expending a spell slot. He regains this use when he finishes a long rest.

features.name: Interception
entries: When a creature Argamon can see hits a target other than Argamon within 5 feet of him, Argamon reduces the damage by 1d10 + 3, to a minimum of 0.

features.name: Guided Strike
entries: When Argamon makes an attack roll, he can use Channel Divinity to gain a +10 bonus to the roll.
